interpretation.main.cod: The adapter declares Node <: Weighted <: Entity. Type selection through a re-exported Packet alias preserves identity and brings methods. Direct score=2; Entity relay=1; nested Entity relay=1; Weighted relay=2.
interpretation.exact-main.cod: A concrete Node extension of the same source score family yields7 through all four paths. Concrete type identity survives Entity admission even though the stronger abstract conformance does not.

mechanism: Value retains its concrete type and one admitted_interface. Parameter/result admission replaces that interface; source lookup otherwise consults the source module conformances. Caller method views carry bodies, not additional conformance facts.
limits: Observed outputs are not a final dispatch contract. Retaining argument-associated conformance versus imposing a declared-interface ceiling requires design review.
